# Rule set fixtures

`resolved.txt` is the golden snapshot of the test `rules::tests::resolved_values_unchanged` in
`src/rules.rs`. It lists every value the rule set gives: the merged rules, the switched-off rules, the
sources and, for each map kind, the scale table, the north-line spacing, the contour proposal, the
description cell and the course symbol sizes, then the purple, the placement weights and the number gap.
It covers the embedded base profile `iof-print` and the test-only overlays of that test.

Generated by the test from the rule loader of commit `09e87ef` (2026-11-09), before the switch to
freemapper-rules, with `FMP_BLESS_RULES=1 cargo test -p freemapper-print --lib resolved_values_unchanged`.
The values come from `rules/iof-print.toml` and the test overlays; the file is released under the same
licence as this repository (GPL-3.0-or-later).
